title: fix(objectql, metadata-protocol)!: by-name doors judge a name's holders over the served set, so a disabled package's item is not a holder (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg7nm31ZnSoWKdR5KwdduBdq)_
epic:#31527#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZWiYtefqQt3DQa9iW

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按名读取包作用域元数据时，「持有者」只算正在提供服务的包。一个名字由启用包和停用包同时持有时，由启用包作答，不再 409 列出两者；只有停用包持有的名字等同无人持有，不再点名停用包。存储引用回填、CLI 报告、picklist 判定这类持久判断仍读全部持有者，停用可逆，绑定不跟着动。
- 为什么改：列表早已隐藏停用包的条目，按名读取却还把它算作持有者，于是列表里只有一个、按名读却 409，或拒绝信息点名一个看不见的包；运维停用撞名包这个补救手段不起作用（ADR-0150 D3，史诗 #31527）。
- 本轮：#32327 的续作，合了最新 main（1 处测试文件冲突，两边保留）。main 新带进来的三个门也随源头过滤移动并已声明：数据集 `?callerPackage=`、连接器按包拉取映射、流程凭据保存的包盖章。
- 风险与回滚：多数答案是放宽（409 变 200）。收窄在进程内库 API 和少数拒绝（见下方 FROM → TO 表），第一方调用方 0。`protocol-exact-qualifier.ts` 那段补丁要等 #32214 合入后再加，在那之前 `?package=停用包` 暂时答 409 而不是 404。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `packageScopedHoldersOf`，再看下方 FROM → TO 表，最后看 `packages/core/src/security/security-catalog.ts`。
- 需要你做的：无。等 #32214 合入后补 qualifier 补丁，再由专题席位安排落地（epic 红线读会核 `holdsPlatformPermissionSet`）。

Fixes #32183

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — for a name that only disabled packages hold, `SchemaRegistry.resolveItem`, `MetadataFacade.get` / `getEntry` and `SchemaRegistry.getApp` (`@objectstack/objectql`) answer `undefined` where they answered the disabled package's body, and `MetadataFacade.exists` answers false where it answered true. A package caller whose closure reaches a name only through a disabled package, while an enabled package outside the closure holds it, is refused `outside-closure`. Every other moved answer widens, names fewer packages, or moves between a refusal and not-found; each is in the table below and in the changeset.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx` already says a disabled module is hidden, and no skill or doc teaches the by-name answer for a name a disabled package holds.

**Narrowing: yes** — first-party callers: **0** (measured on the predecessor's step 0: showcase 22 packages / 205 package-scoped names, crm 18 / 35, multi-package 16 / 27; no name has two holders and no package is disabled at boot).

**Supersedes #32327.** This is #32327's branch (`claude/project-thread-ryhc4d` at `1b655c3cd`, contract review r3 PASS 6781597322) carried onto this branch with `main` merged in: this session may push only its own designated branch, so the resume opens here, as claim 6810227359 provides. Every commit of #32327 is in this branch's history unchanged. #32327 is left open for the seat to close.

## Moved answers (FROM → TO)

FROM is `main` at `f0f729e7`; TO is this head. First-party count 0 on every row. Rows marked **new** come from doors `main` added since #32327's last merge; the others were declared on #32327 and are unchanged.

| # | Door or reader | Case | FROM | TO | Arm | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `SchemaRegistry.resolveItem`, `MetadataFacade.get` / `getEntry`, `getApp` | only disabled packages hold the name | the disabled body (`exists` true) | `undefined` (`exists` false) | narrowing (library) | objectql `package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts` |
| 2 | `packageScopedHoldersOf`, `resolvePackageScopedName`, `readPackageScopedItem`, `resolveActionByPackage` | same, caller with no package or outside the closure | `[DISABLED]`, resolved to it | `[]`, not-found | narrowing (library) | objectql `package-scoped-resolver.test.ts` |
| 3 | `resolvePackageScopedName`, `resolveItem(type, name, caller)`, `resolveActionByPackage` | the caller's closure reaches the name only through a disabled package; an enabled one outside holds it | the disabled body | refused `outside-closure`, naming the enabled holder | narrowing | objectql `package-scoped-resolver.test.ts` |
| 4 | bare `GET /meta/:type/:name`, every type of the live `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` (now with `permission`), both transports; MCP `agent_prompt`, the dataset query door's bare `datasetName`, the import door's `mappingName`, a connector pull naming no package | two holders, one disabled | 409 naming both | 200, the enabled holder's item | widening | runtime `meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`, rest `meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts` |
| 5 | bare `/layers` | same | 409 naming both | 200, the enabled holder's stack (code layer, overlay row, lock) | widening | same, and `meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts` |
| 6 | bare `/published` | same | 409 naming both | the enabled holder's row, else the service copy at its package, else 404 | widening | `meta-disabled-holder-artifact-door.test.ts`, `meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts` |
| 7 | `/meta/:type/:ns/:name` of a shareable namespace, and bare | two co-owners, one disabled | 409 `ambiguous-in-namespace` | 200, the enabled co-owner's item | widening | runtime / rest qualified-read files |
| 8 | `resolveActionByPackage`, the REST route rung for a caller's package | caller with no package, or a closure holding both | refused | the enabled holder's declaration and handler | widening | objectql and runtime `action-package-addressing.test.ts`, `actions-disabled-holder-door.test.ts` |
| 9 | security catalog reference with no package column; `holdsPlatformPermissionSet` | two holders, one disabled | refused; false | the enabled holder's set; its platform verdict | widening (epic read) | core `security-catalog.test.ts` |
| 10 | **new** `?callerPackage=P` on `GET /meta/dataset/:name` and the dataset query doors (single, batch) | two holders in P's closure, one disabled | 409 naming both | 200, the enabled holder's dataset | widening | runtime / rest, `#32183 × #32310` describe |
| 11 | **new** connector pull of a job's mapping, package caller | two holders in the closure, one disabled | 409 `mapping_name_refused` naming both | the enabled holder's mapping is pulled | widening | service-automation `connector-pull.test.ts` |
| 12 | **new** flow credential channel write (the flow save door's store) | a flow name an enabled and a disabled package hold; a save that sets, clears or removes a stored credential | 409 naming both | written, rows stamped `flow_package` = the enabled holder | widening | service-automation `stored-reference-package-column.test.ts` (`flowHolderPackage`) |
| 13 | `?package=NONHOLDER`, a non-holding namespace path, `_env` | two holders, one disabled | 409 naming both | 409 naming the enabled holder | names fewer | runtime / rest |
| 14 | action or permission-set caller outside both closures | same | refused naming both | refused naming the enabled holder | names fewer | objectql, core |
| 15 | permission-set caller | disabled holder inside the closure, enabled outside | not-found | refused `outside-closure`, naming the enabled holder | refusal | core |
| 16 | **new** `?callerPackage=P` | P's closure reaches the name only through a disabled package; an enabled one outside holds it | 404 (the disabled item, withheld) | 409 `outside-closure`, naming the enabled holder | refusal | runtime / rest, `#32183 × #32310` describe |
| 17 | `_env`, `?package=NONHOLDER` and its qualified path | only disabled packages hold the name | 409 naming the disabled package | 404 | not-found | runtime / rest |
| 18 | bare read | two or more disabled packages, nothing else | 409 naming them | 404 | not-found | runtime / rest |
| 19 | shareable namespace path | both co-owners disabled | 409 `ambiguous-in-namespace` | 404 | not-found | runtime / rest |
| 20 | stored permission-set column naming the disabled holder | two holders, one disabled | refused naming both | not-found, never re-targeted | not-found | core |
| 21 | action or permission-set caller outside the closure | only a disabled package holds the name | refused naming it | not-found | not-found | objectql, core |
| 22 | REST action rung with `callerPackageId` | the execution read throws a package-scoped refusal | `degraded` | the declared 409 | refusal (no door reaches it) | runtime `action-package-addressing.test.ts` |

**Interim, until the owed hunk (ruling (c)):** with two holders where one is disabled, `?package=DISABLED`, the disabled package's namespace path, the disabled base's `.custom` pair, and (**new**) `?callerPackage=P` when P's own holding is the disabled one beside an enabled dependency, answer 409 `not-held-by-qualifier` naming the enabled holder, where `main` answers 404. The hunk restores the 404 (raw admission at the exact qualifier) and pins all four on both transports. The changeset's "Not moved" line describes the answer after that hunk.

**Not moved:** `?package=DISABLED` and its namespace (after the hunk); every holder's own read; the served lists; durable judgments (R1/R3, R4, R5/R6/R13, R7–R11, R20 backfills; `os migrate stored-references`; `picklistReferenceVerdict`), which read every holder; the install gate (`bareNamePackageHolders`, epic stance 6766291071) and the security catalog's item seam.

## What changes

Unchanged from #32327 at `1b655c3cd` (its body is the full account; the contract review r3 PASS 6781597322 read it):

- **The holder set is the served set** (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, `packageScopedHoldersOf`): a disabled package's holding is left out, except the caller's own; `options.includeDisabledPackages: true` reads every holder, forwarded by `resolvePackageScopedName`, the action addressing wrapper and the install door's pending-manifest view.
- **Durable judgments read every holder**: the stored-reference backfills (permission sets, sharing declarations, email templates, the activation ledger, R7–R11 through `AutomationEngine.durableFlowHolder` and the connector resolver's `options`), the CLI stored-reference report and `picklistReferenceVerdict`.
- **The security catalog** never re-targets a disabled holder's column, reads an only-disabled name as not-found, and `holdsPlatformPermissionSet` judges the served holders.
- **The item face** answers a name every holder of which is disabled as that package's withheld item; **the bare reads take the served holder's stack** (`servedHolderAddressOf`, `isAnotherHoldersCopy`); both `/published` doors and `MetadataManager.getPublished(type, name, packageId?)` read at the served holder's package.
- **The REST action rung** answers a thrown package-scoped refusal as the declared 409.

This round (resume):

- **`main` merged** at `f0f729e7` (no rebase), commit `7056f7084`. One textual conflict, `packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`: both sides added a top-level `describe` after the review-F4 block (this branch's route-rung pins; `main`'s #32244 bare-action-read pins). Both are kept, in that order. Thirteen other files both sides touched merged cleanly; I read each overlap (registry, resolver, layered reads, metadata manager, `domains/meta.ts`, action execution, service-automation engine, plugin, connector scope and backfill).
- **Doors `main` added, now judging the served set through the source** (no edit to their modules except one docblock): the `?callerPackage=` arm (#32310, rows 10 and 16), the connector pull's mapping for a package caller (#32294, row 11), and the flow credential channel's row stamp (#32302, row 12). Each is pinned and declared in the changeset.
- **`packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-package-scope.ts`**: docblock only. `withholdDisabledHolder` said this change "does not touch" it and that a disabled holder beside an enabled one "still counts"; both are no longer true. Its `outside-closure` arm is now unreachable (the served set never names a disabled package outside the closure); I left the code, and the seat may drop it.
- **Two pins `main` wrote for the old answer moved** (`connector-pull.test.ts`): the `CONTROL (#32183's class)` case (a disabled holder beside an enabled one still counts) and the no-package half of the case beside it. Both now assert the served answer and, re-enabled, the refusal.
- **`permission` joined `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` on `main` (#32162)**, and the served-holder pins iterate the live list, so they ship a permission set under two packages, which the security catalog's item seam refuses at registration. The three loops (objectql e8 readers, runtime and rest qualified reads) lift that one seam for `permission`, as `main`'s own `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` does (`admitSecondPermissionHolder`). Rows 4–7, 13 and 17–19 now cover `permission`.
- **Redundant, left as is:** `main`'s `refuseActionHeldByPackages` (#32361) filters disabled holders at the action door; the source filter makes that filter a no-op. Its store-refusal reader (`rethrowPackageScopedRefusal`) still matters, because the metadata service counts disabled holders.

### Owed before ACCEPT: the exact-qualifier hunk (ruling (c))

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts` is untouched. After #32214 merges and the seat says go: merge `main`, then admission over every holder (`includeDisabledPackages: true`) with served candidates, `resolveMetaItemAddress` falling back to a holding owner over every holder, and pins for `?package=DISABLED`, `/meta/:type/DISABLED_NS/:name`, the `.custom` pair of a disabled base, and `?callerPackage=P` with P's own holding disabled, all 404 on both transports, never naming the enabled holder. Then a delta contract review, the dogfood battery on the final head, and the epic red-line read (`holdsPlatformPermissionSet` false → the enabled holder's verdict, row 9).

## Why

The served list (`listItems`) has withheld a disabled package's items since the disable landed, and the item face answers 404 for one. But `packageScopedHoldersOf` read the raw store, so every ADR-0150 D3 door still counted the disabled package as a holder. The epic ruling 6766102988 names the served list as the right holder set.
